notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility
notes.notes:
Steam has awarded our game a [b]Playable[/b] badge regarding Steam Deck compatibility. That’s not bad, considering we never specifically developed for this console.

I think what separates us from a [b]Verified[/b] rating are the small fonts in some game elements (cell phone texts, the end of the Credits) and something they call Controller Glyphs (likely the mouse cursor).

In any case, we can confirm - and it's supported by feedback from some players - that [b]Whispers of Prague[/b] is fully playable on Steam Deck.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update Notes for patch 1.0.10
notes.notes: Once again, thanks to your feedback, we fixed a bunch of typos that slipped into the texts in various parts of the game and added some missing descriptions.

notes.title: Update Notes for patch 1.0.9
notes.notes: Thank you very much to everyone who sent us feedback on the game. Thanks to you, we fixed many [b]typos in the texts[/b] that escaped our attention despite intensive testing. In addition, we made slight adjustments to some [b]images[/b] so they better fit into the overall scene.
